best_hook.why: A sobbing mother cups her scarred son's face and says 'I buried you.': the presumed-dead son reveal in three words.

best_cliffhanger.why: 'The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now.': a conspiracy reveal that lands on the mother's frozen dread, with nothing resolved.

must_promos.why: Fist crushing the map on 'My men were slaughtered', then shot and left for dead, 'someone wanted you to believe I was dead', 'someone ordered my men to die', building to the reveal that the conspirators now rule Ashwood.
'I buried you.' / 'They told me your entire regiment was destroyed.' / 'Then how did you survive?' / 'I wasn't supposed to.': a short reunion cut ending on an ominous answer.

standalone_risk: In the conspiracy cut a stranger is not told the woman is his mother, and 'the men ruling Ashwood' are never named, so the final reveal lands only as vague menace; the Crown mission and Iberian front exposition is heavy.
notes: The escape tunnel and blizzard trek (00:00-00:27) look good but have no hook-strength moment; the episode is a static two-hander once inside the cabin.
